header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile, Start Game, then Start (Enter) through the logos and the title to the file select, A (Space) on a
new file into the mode select and through the Millennium Star's greeting, the stick left (A) onto the Battle Royale
star, and A through the rules question and the party's setup onto that map's first board, Chilly Waters, where A
rolls the dice for player 1 and the computer plays the other three. Which screen is up is the overlay omOvlGotoEx
last went to, omovl (0x800CE200): the file select 0x79, the mode select 0x77, the setup 0x78, the boards 0x48 (Chilly
Waters) to 0x4E. The mode select's glove is a word of its own at 0x8010F730, 0 until the greeting ends, then the
glove's x: 0xAC on the middle star, 0x90 on the Battle Royale star. The stick moves it only while the hub shows what
